summary: Red River Bancshares, Inc. filed an 8-K to announce a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share, declared by its board on August 27, 2026. The dividend is payable on September 17, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 8, 2026. This is a standard capital return event, not a special situation. The filing includes a press release and cover page. There is no unusual action, strategic change, or event signaling a special situation. The announcement is consistent with ordinary dividend declarations by a bank holding company. What to watch: none, as this is routine market news.
